title: Steric control of signaling bias in the immunometabolic receptor GPR84
authors: Wang P; Zhang X; Guseinov A; Jenkins L; von Hallerstein C; Colburn JD; Ives R; Luscombe VB; Marsango S; Oktavia L; Raja A; Greaves DR; Biggin PC; Milligan G; Zhang C; Tikhonova I; Russell AJ
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过冷冻电镜和分子动力学模拟揭示GPR84配体立体效应调控信号偏向的机制，但对象为折叠的GPCR而非无序蛋白/IDR，且聚焦配体-受体而非PPI，机制建模思路对IDP互作研究仅有有限迁移启发。
abstract: Biased signaling in G protein-coupled receptors offers therapeutic promise, yet rational design of biased ligands remains challenging due to limited mechanistic understanding. Here, we report a molecular framework for controlling signaling bias at the immunometabolic receptor GPR84. We identified three structurally-matched ligands (OX04529, OX04954, and OX04539) with varying steric profiles that exhibit comparable Gi protein activation but dramatically different β-arrestin recruitment capacities. A high-resolution cryo-EM structure of GPR84-Gi in complex with OX04529, complemented by molecular dynamics simulations and targeted mutagenesis, revealed that steric interactions between ligand substituents and Leu3366.52 and Phe1875.47 indirectly disrupt a critical polar network involving Tyr3326.48, Asn1043.36 and Asn3627.45 essential for β-arrestin recruitment. Based on these insights, we developed a steric-dependent model that enabled rational design of G protein-biased agonists with predictable β-arrestin recruitment profiles. This mechanistic framework provides a blueprint for designing biased agonists with customized signaling profiles at GPR84 and potentially other class A GPCRs.
abstract_zh: G蛋白偶联受体中的偏向信号传导具有治疗前景，然而由于机制理解有限，偏向配体的合理设计仍具挑战性。在此，我们报告了一个用于控制免疫代谢受体GPR84信号传导偏向的分子框架。我们鉴定了三种结构匹配的配体（OX04529、OX04954和OX04539），它们具有不同的空间位阻特征，表现出相当的Gi蛋白激活能力，但β-arrestin招募能力显著不同。GPR84-Gi与OX04529复合物的高分辨率冷冻电镜结构，辅以分子动力学模拟和靶向突变分析，揭示了配体取代基与Leu3366.52和Phe1875.47之间的空间相互作用间接破坏了涉及Tyr3326.48、Asn1043.36和Asn3627.45的关键极性网络，该网络对β-arrestin招募至关重要。基于这些见解，我们开发了一个空间位阻依赖模型，使得能够合理设计具有可预测β-arrestin招募谱的G蛋白偏向激动剂。这一机制框架为在GPR84及潜在的其他A类GPCR上设计具有定制信号谱的偏向激动剂提供了蓝图。
